title: Gawlf
description: is a turn-based multiplayer game to play online with friends, based on the classic playing card game Golf, made using React and Ruby on Rails.

title: Statchasing
description: is a site for Rocket League players, made with React and Ruby on Rails, which provides interesting analytic data in addition to what can be found on [ballchasing.com](https://ballchasing.com), via its API.

title: The Technology Store
description: is a mock store made with React to practice implementing client-side routing using the React Router DOM library, featuring dummy products sourced from [Fake Store API](https://fakestoreapi.com/).

title: Frendo
description: is a social media clone built with Ruby on Rails, complete with authentication using Devise, user profiles, and following functionality.

title: Poké-Memory
description: is a simple memory game made with React using images sourced from [PokéAPI](https://pokeapi.co/).

title: Battleship
description: is exactly what you think: a classic game of battleship, to be played against a computer opponent, written in vanilla JavaScript.

title: Weather App
description: (as the name suggests) checks the current weather in any city using [Visual Crossing's API](https://www.visualcrossing.com/weather-api), including the temperature in both Fahrenheit or Celsius. Also displays a cute icon depending on weather conditions!

title: TBD✓
description: is a site that lets you track life's many projects and tasks with ease. Featuring persisting data, dynamic light/dark theme based on your system's theme, and some fancy animations.
